body_markdown:
It would be lovely if I could just type in new global classifiers in the training menu instead of having to find them in articles.


I think there is also a lot of potential for improving flexibility related to global classifiers by adding systems for either weighting or rules or both.


I can imagine an option to create groups of global classifiers, and then assign a priority for them, or rules for the classifiers. For example, I am a researcher on auto industry lobbying. Adding The names of automakers and regulations does decently well, but picks up fluff every time a “Ford” vehicle crashes into a building. It would be great if I could group classifiers and create rules for the groups, so for example: I take my group of automaker names I am interested in, and make a rule that will prioritize articles that also mention my group of “names of regulations and industry keywords”, so that I see more articles that reference both Ford and Fuel Economy Standards. This could be contained in an advanced tab, so as not to bog down the current setup.


Love the project though and I am new here so maybe I’m just missing something. Thank you for your work!
